## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: Rollback runnable WITHOUT post-migration format intact.

## Implementation Notes
tests/scripts/test-rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh:
- Given corrupted v1.2.0 ledger: rollback runs (no v1.2.0 dependency).
- Given branch protection required state: rollback demotes to non-required or removes new check-contexts entirely.
- Given migration-grace labels on PRs: rollback removes them.
- Workflow file rollback: restores prior ci.yml + deletes review-sub-pr.yml (or accepts that workflow files are handled separately).
- Idempotent.

Add .test-index marker [test_rollback_sub_pr_cutover].

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test exists, RED
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh && ! bash tests/scripts/test-rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh
- [ ] Asserts rollback runs on corrupted state
  Verify: grep -qE 'corrupted|broken' tests/scripts/test-rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh
data.title: S_mig.T8: RED test rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh (independent of post-migration format)
